lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The middle row contains approximately 8 to 10 prominent, well-spaced nodes between the gills and the vertical axis of the first dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of alternating pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like structure where the highest-intensity blobs are centered within the lighter vertical segments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible across the flank. The mid-lateral ridge is the most prominent, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and a defined shadow edge on the ventral side.
